english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for conduct or things regarded as disgraceful or socially embarrassing.
Use this when the behaviour is especially socially embarrassing or reflects badly on the person, rather than simply lacking manners.
Use this when the person's behavior is specifically embarrassing, improper, or likely to offend others.
Choose this when the embarrassment comes from behavior that is rude, improper, or disrespectful.

examples.english: Yelling at people that loudly at someone else’s wedding is really shameful.
examples.traditional: 你喺人哋婚禮上面咁大聲鬧人，真係好失禮。
examples.jyutping: nei5 hai2 jan4 dei6 fan1 lai5 soeng6 min6 gam2 daai6 seng1 naau6 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 lai5

examples.english: Starting to eat before the host does at someone else's home is really impolite.
examples.traditional: 喺人哋屋企食飯，唔等主人開餐就食，真係好失禮。
examples.jyutping: hai2 jan4 dei6 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6 m4 dang2 zyu2 jan4 hoi1 caan1 zau6 sik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 lai5

examples.english: You said the food was bad in front of the host at their home; that was gauche.
examples.traditional: 你喺人哋屋企當住主人面話啲餸難食，真係失禮。
examples.jyutping: nei5 hai2 jan4 dei6 uk1 kei2 dong1 zyu6 zyu2 jan4 min6 waa6 di1 sung3 naan4 sik6 zan1 hai6 sat1 lai5

examples.english: Being late when meeting someone for the first time is really embarrassing.
examples.traditional: 第一次見人就遲到，真係好失禮。
examples.jyutping: dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 jan4 zau6 ci4 dou3 zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 lai5
